Map of Nippur 

 

 

 

 

This drawing is based on a map of the ancient city of Nippur made about 1500 BC. Nippur was a Babylonian city located south of the capital city of Babylon on the Euphrates River. Compare this to a 
modern map of archeological excavations at Nippur.
